description: One aircraft inside a zone horizontally (or none, for the height limit), judged vertically. Each limit is compared in its own reference and never converted with a single number: AMSL against AMSL altitude; AGL against AMSL minus the DEM ground under the aircraft; WGS84 against AMSL plus the geoid undulation. terrain: 'none' (not configured), 'unknown here', or ground_m. expected.raised is what one observation raises; counters show zone_checks_not_evaluated (silent, not judged) and zone_limits_not_judged (warned because AGL could not be judged).

units.alt_amsl_m/ground_m/limits: metres unless the zone says FT

generated: Expected values computed by knowledge/tools/gen_vectors.py, which runs the old Python implementation (rootxkit/utm @ 484cd228035f) on these inputs. Regenerate rather than edit.
